title: Python Developer
tagline: Write clean Python, then build web APIs on top of it
description: Go from Python basics to professional habits: object-oriented design, data structures and algorithms, a web framework (Django or FastAPI), relational data with SQL and a testing discipline that keeps your code reliable.
audience: Beginners who like Python and developers moving into Python back ends

stages.title: Python
stages.description: Syntax, data types, functions, modules, files and the standard library.

stages.title: Object-oriented programming
stages.description: Classes, inheritance, composition and SOLID principles applied in Python.

stages.title: Data structures and algorithms
stages.description: Lists, dictionaries, stacks, queues, trees, sorting, searching and Big-O.

stages.title: Django or FastAPI
stages.description: Build a web application with Django or an API with FastAPI.

stages.title: SQL
stages.description: Model data, write queries and connect your application to PostgreSQL or SQLite.

stages.title: Testing
stages.description: Unit tests, fixtures, mocking and test-driven development with pytest.

seo.title: Python Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap from Python fundamentals through OOP, data structures, Django or FastAPI, SQL and testing for Python developers.
